codex.promisedend.act.edge.sealed: Sealed until the Void Leviathan is defeated. The last pages are about a place that was never finished.

codex.promisedend.act.outer.sealed: Sealed until you hold a Void Anchor. The Ancients wrote these pages for those who could find their way back.
codex.promisedend.act.void.sealed: Sealed until the guardian of the Shulker Foundry is defeated.
codex.promisedend.closing: The last of us kept this for you. You broke what we raised, and we are glad. The heart is open. End what we only began.
codex.promisedend.goal.mine_voidstone.hi: The Rim, on the way in
codex.promisedend.page.1: If you are reading this, you came through a portal we did not build for you. The End is yours now, as much as it was ever ours. Take what you need. Finish what you can.
codex.promisedend.page.10: We did not plant the chorus. It came up through our floors and would not stop. We learned to cut it, then to build with it. The End grows what it wants. We only ever chose where.
codex.promisedend.page.11: In the Foundry we grew purpur the way a reef grows coral, and the shulkers grew in it, shells first. They were our masons. Few of the things we made are tame now.
codex.promisedend.page.12: From the towers we charted the void: where the currents run, where the islands drift, where the far edge frays into nothing. Our charts still point true. The towers did not last as well.
codex.promisedend.page.13: We tied the islands together with Rift Gates, a lily and a shard to wake each one. A gate knows whoever woke it. We did not want our roads open to everyone. Now no one is left to walk them but you.
codex.promisedend.page.14: At the shrines we left what we could spare: a little grace for the glide, a little sense for the pearl. Bring an altar what the End grows and it will remember how to give.
codex.promisedend.page.15: Sentries for the doors, Wardens for the crystals, Wisps to carry the light. We built them to keep our work, and most keep it still, against anyone: we never taught them who would come after.
codex.promisedend.page.16: The Architect shaped islands out of raw lattice, drawing them up from the dark like nets from water. It never rested and it never spoke. When we left, it went out to the edge, to wait for the work.
codex.promisedend.page.17: Far out, past the last of the lands, the islands stop. Not broken: unfinished. Lattice with nothing on it, a citadel with no roof. That is where the work stopped, and where the Architect waits.
codex.promisedend.page.18: The more we raised, the more the void took back. Islands came loose. Whole shores sank in a night. We could not finish it and we could not stop, so we chose to wait.
codex.promisedend.page.19: We asked the dragon to guard the heart while we were gone, and when it would not be asked, we bound it. It holds the centre now. It is angrier every time it wakes.
codex.promisedend.page.2: Round the heart we raised the Ward, so that no one would wake the dragon before they were ready. Three seals hold it, and three guardians the seals. Break all three and the Ward will fall.
codex.promisedend.page.20: We did not die. We left, as builders leave when the stone runs out, meaning to come back. The tools are still where we put them down. The chests are still full.
codex.promisedend.page.21: The ring round the heart was our first road out from it. It broke when we bound the dragon, and it has floated in pieces since. Cross it island by island, with an anchor on you.
codex.promisedend.page.22: The dragon remembers every fall. Each time it comes back it is stronger, and its hoard grows with it. If you fight it again, know that it will remember you too.
codex.promisedend.page.23: We promised that the End would be finished. We could not do it. Perhaps the promise was never ours to keep. Perhaps it waited for someone who would end what we only began.
codex.promisedend.page.24: When the dragon falls the binding breaks, and the End is yours, not ours. It will rise again; let it. Do not mourn the work. Build. That was always the promise: not that we would finish, but that you would go on.
codex.promisedend.page.3: The Sentinel's shell turns any blow. Its own shots it cannot turn. Strike them back at it and it will open. We made it proud of its shell, and it never learned to fear what it throws.
codex.promisedend.page.4: The Hollow Sentinel at the Foundry. The Void Leviathan in the Rift Maw. The Architect at the edge, behind amber. Each was ours. Each will fight you as if you were the void itself.
codex.promisedend.page.5: We came through the portal to a sky with nothing in it but one island and the dark. We set a stone at its edge and said: this will be a world. We said it to each other, and then to the void.
codex.promisedend.page.6: Every island the dark had swallowed, we would raise again. Every shore would grow a thing of its own. We cut it into the first gate and called it the Promise, and we were young enough to believe it.
codex.promisedend.page.7: The dragon was here before us. It did not fight us. It watched us build from the crystal towers and it waited, the way a tide waits. We took that for a blessing. We were wrong about many things.
codex.promisedend.page.8: Half of us were lost to the void in the first years. Then we learned to bind a pearl to the deep stone, so that whoever falls is pulled back once. Carry one. The void keeps what it is given.
codex.promisedend.page.9: We set Waystations where the portals come out, so that no one would arrive alone: a gate home, a chest, a chart. Whoever finds this, it was left for you, though we never knew your name.
